allPhases.label: Standard schedule
allPhases.duration: Continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
allPhases.summary: Sunitinib 37.5 mg orally once daily continuously

phases.label: Standard schedule
phases.duration: Continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
phases.summary: Sunitinib 37.5 mg orally once daily continuously. The 28-day cycle is a review interval, with no scheduled off-week.

components.note: Continuous daily treatment without a scheduled off-week. Take at the same time each day, consistently with or without food; swallow whole with water. Missed dose: no additional dose; take the usual prescribed dose the following day.
